lamps.steady: Reminds you to fasten seat belt. Blinks and buzzer sounds until buckled.
lamps.flashing: Blinks along with an audio buzzer if unfastened while driving.

lamps.steady: Malfunction in the airbag system. Remove CRS and contact Tata Motors authorised service center.
lamps.flashing: SRS is malfunctioning. Visit Tata Motors authorised service centre immediately.

lamps.steady: Fuel level in the tank is low; fuel needs to be filled immediately.
lamps.flashing: Fault in the fuel system. Take your vehicle to the nearest Tata Motors Authorized service centre.

lamps.steady: Coolant temperature is high/overheating. Stop vehicle, switch off engine, allow to cool, and contact Tata Motors authorized service centre.
lamps.flashing: Coolant temperature is very high or at hazardous level. Stop vehicle, switch off engine, allow to cool, and contact Tata Motors authorized service centre.

lamps.steady: DEF level is low in tank, or warns of emission issues.
Engine related fault that may increase emission levels. Contact Tata Motors Authorised Service Centre.
Fault arises in Engine Management System. Contact Tata Motors authorized service centre.
Problem with key/system. Contact a Tata Motors Authorized Service Centre.
lamps.flashing: Vehicle is in immobilized condition when key is not inserted.

lamps.steady: Ignition key is in ON position; start engine only after this indicator goes OFF.

lamps.flashing: Indicates direction of turn signal when operating left/right indicator or hazard switch.

lamps.steady: High beam headlamps are switched ON or flashed.
Fault in electrical circuit or lubrication system. Contact Tata Motors Authorized service centre.
Battery is not getting charged. Switch off unnecessary electrical equipment and contact Tata Motors Authorized service centre.
Turned ON for 4 seconds at ignition, or stays ON if seat belt is unfastened and speed is under 15 kmph.
lamps.flashing: Speed goes above 15 kmph with unfastened belt; flashes with audio chime for 90 seconds.

lamps.steady: HHC malfunction. Take your vehicle to nearest Tata authorized service centre at the earliest.
Continuously remains ON indicating a fault. Contact Tata Motors Authorized service centre immediately.
lamps.flashing: Blinks indicating a fault. Contact Tata Motors Authorized service centre immediately.

lamps.lamp: Park Brake / Brake Fluid Low / EBD Malfunction
lamps.steady: Brake fluid is low, parking brake is applied, or EBD is malfunctioning.
Malfunction in ABS. Normal braking remains operational without ABS. Contact Tata Motors Authorized service centre.
Cruise control feature is present and activated.

lamps.lamp: Press Clutch Pedal to Start Engine
lamps.steady: Comes on until user presses the clutch pedal to start the engine.
Excess water accumulated in fuel filter. Contact Tata Motors Authorised service centre to drain immediately.
Day Time Running lamps are ON to increase vehicle visibility during daytime.
Indicates respective door or tailgate is open.
Hill Descent Control system is at fault condition. Take vehicle to nearest Tata authorized service centre.
Rear fog lamp is switched ON.
Front fog lamp is switched ON.
Valid Smart key is not detected inside the vehicle.
ESP system is at fault condition. Take your vehicle to nearest Tata authorized service center.
Co-driver seatbelt is unfastened while occupied by an adult.
lamps.flashing: Speed goes above 15 kmph with unfastened co-driver seatbelt; final audio warning goes on for 90 seconds.

lamps.steady: Vehicle speed crosses 80 kmph or 120 kmph, staying ON with audio chimes until speed is reduced.
DPF needs regeneration because soot regeneration is insufficient. Keep car running at 3rd gear, 60 kmph, over 2000 rpm until complete.
lamps.flashing: DPF needs to eliminate trapped pollutants through regeneration process.

lamps.steady: Economy drive mode is active for better fuel economy.
Sport drive mode is active when more torque is required.
City drive mode is active for optimum torque with fuel economy.
Malfunction in the catalyst health / SCR system.
